beta_stability.method: agreement of the beta estimate across the two halves of the 180d window

beta_strength.method: positive OLS beta against BINANCE:BTCUSDT.P + BINANCE:ETHUSDT.P + BINANCE:SOLUSDT.P, scaled so beta 2.0 reads 100

factor_r2.method: multivariate OLS with intercept on BINANCE:BTCUSDT.P + BINANCE:ETHUSDT.P + BINANCE:SOLUSDT.P

independence.method: derived as 100 - factor_r2 by the builder

liquidity.method: Frozen core cohorts retained; new Beta use sourced 30-session quote-turnover percentiles from 444 actual instruments. Per-record hashes disclose cohorts.

notes: Rebuilt under 0.8: Light is leader-only, Medium covers most reviewed leaders, Heavy completes the reviewed leader/necessary-peer roster plus a small Beta tail. Max adds at least 30% to this Heavy, entirely as Beta. Leader coverage uses the declared reviewed roster, not an exhaustive market census.

Coverage Beta means supplementary business/token observation relative to named core members, ranked by sourced capitalization. Price beta, R2 and stability are auxiliary descriptors, not admission floors or quality scores. The role alone does not claim high price sensitivity.

Max follows Heavy display-group entity proportions, with integer rounding only. Deficit-group places cannot be heavily redirected. Compact presentation preserves original economic duties and member facts.

Reviewed core token identities/economics and exact-instrument prices through 2026-10-04 are reused. Listing records span 10-05 through 10-07; sourced circulating USD capitalization is dated 10-07, never FDV. This is not a full live token-risk refresh.

Actual 30-session turnover measurements remain sourced. Equity turnover can use raw-close times volume as a disclosed proxy. Cohorts differ between research rounds; records preserve their hashes/populations. No unified cross-cohort percentile ranking is claimed.
References are preserved separately and do not consume entity/growth counts; they do consume export limits.

Validation proves contract, identity, dated evidence, measurement provenance and distribution compliance, not independent leadership truth or business quality. Cap priority applies within the reviewed admissible bench, not the whole market.
No future-price evaluation or TradingView UI-import test performed. Historical round notes are archived separately; JSON retains per-member evidence, measurements and exclusions.
Protocol identity, ecosystem, token role, venue and units remain explicit. Market capitalization is not holder revenue, token ownership is not company equity, and multi-venue Core scope is preserved.
